event_summary: El Mencho, CJNG leader, killed in military raid in Tapalpa, Jalisco. US military-led group aided the operation.
CJNG retaliation after El Mencho killing. 25 National Guard members killed in 6 separate attacks across Jalisco.
Continued CJNG retaliatory violence spreads to Michoacan, civilians caught in crossfire.
DEA-led operation targeting CJNG results in 670 arrests across multiple US and Mexico states. Large fentanyl and cash seizures.
Record homicide day in Sinaloa during internal Chapitos vs Mayos civil war. 17 killed in single day in Culiacan.
One-year cumulative report: Sinaloa civil war between Chapitos and Mayos factions leaves 1828 dead and 2390 missing since El Mayo arrest.
Ismael 'El Mayo' Zambada, Sinaloa Cartel co-founder, arrested and extradited to the US. Triggered massive internal cartel war.
ODNI identifies and locates top Sinaloa Plaza Boss. Arrested with US intelligence assistance.
Trump formally designates Mexican cartels as terrorist organizations. Increases pressure on Mexico for military cooperation.
New US military-led intelligence group revealed to have aided Mexico in locating El Mencho. First known direct US military intel role in Mexico cartel operation.
Mexican security forces ambushed by armed Sinaloa cartel group. 13 attackers killed in Sinaloa state confrontation.
DEA indicts Los Zetas/CDN brothers Miguel (Z-40) and Omar (Z-42) Trevino Morales for decades of violence, murder, and drug trafficking.
Joaquin Guzman Lopez (El Chapo's son) self-surrendered to US federal authorities alongside El Mayo. Key trigger of Sinaloa internal war.
One year after El Mayo arrest — civilian targeting and gang clashes almost quadrupled. Cumulative violence milestone recorded by ACLED.
ACLED spike recorded — September 2025 marked official onset of full Sinaloa civil war. Homicides rose 400% compared to pre-El Mayo arrest levels.
US CBP records peak fentanyl seizure year — 21,846 lbs (9,909 kg) seized at Mexico-US border in FY2023, 164% increase since 2020. Sinaloa and CJNG dominant suppliers.
Fentanyl seizures at US-Mexico border drop sharply to 760 lbs in March 2025, down from 3,220 lbs peak in April 2023. Reflects shift in trafficking patterns.
Post El Mencho killing — soldiers continue clash with CJNG for second day. Total post-killing death toll reaches 70+. US tourists issued shelter-in-place warnings.
Mexican President Sheinbaum consolidates power post El Mencho killing. US increases pressure on Mexico for military cooperation against cartels.
CJNG sets fire to vehicles, blocks highways, forces civilian lockdowns across major Mexican cities in coordinated retaliation for El Mencho killing.
Mexican troops kill 19 suspected Sinaloa cartel members in major shootout in Culiacan. Violence surge linked to El Mayo arrest fallout.
Gulf Cartel faction shootout near Rio Grande captured by Texas DPS thermal imaging. Heavy firepower and explosives used less than 1 mile from Donna, Texas.
CJNG vs Sinaloa Cartel clash in Chiapas — armed interactions quadrupled vs 2022. Mexico deploys 1,500 army and police to restore order.
Mexican SSP arrests 2 cartel members extorting avocado and lemon growers in Apatzingan, Michoacan. Operation involved army, national guard, and state police.
President of lime growers association killed in his car after publicly complaining about CJNG extortion in Michoacan.
End of 2024 report — Sinaloa civil war deepens as Chapitos vs Mayos conflict spreads. Myth of the 'good narco' collapses as civilian targeting surges.
La Familia Michoacana vs local groups intensifies in Guerrero. Fighting over gold mine access drives surge in violence. ACLED 2024 watchlist flags Guerrero as high-risk.
CJNG sets vehicles ablaze in Puerto Vallarta after El Mencho killing. 300 tourists stranded at airport. US State Dept issues shelter-in-place advisory for Americans.
CJNG blocks roads and burns banks and pharmacies in Guadalajara — FIFA 2026 World Cup host city. Jalisco governor declares code red, suspends all public transport.
Mexico Peace Index 2024 report: organized crime rate rose 62.4% over 9 years. ~400 active criminal groups operating across Mexico.
Journalist Miguel Angel Beltran found dead on Durango-Sinaloa highway wrapped in blanket with cartel note. 13th journalist killed in Mexico in 2025.
After El Mencho killing, CJNG attacks journalists Belizario Reyes and Juvencio Villanueva from Noroeste newspaper in Sinaloa while they were on assignment.
Anti-crime mayor Carlos Alberto Manzo Rodriguez killed by cartel gunmen during Day of the Dead festivities in Michoacan.
ACLED report: Sinaloa Cartel rift redrawing Mexico criminal map. Tijuana clashes rise 16% as Chapitos, CJNG and Tijuana Cartel contest key US border corridor.
CJNG intensifies dispute with Sinaloa Cartel over Manzanillo port — key hub for Pacific drug trafficking. Leveraging Sinaloa internal war to expand.
Full-scale Sinaloa Cartel civil war erupts on Sep 9, 2024. ACLED marks this as official outbreak date — gang clashes and civilian targeting reach record highs never seen since 2018.
Mexico Peace Index 2025: ~400 active criminal groups in Mexico. Organized crime undermines regional stability. Trump pressure accelerating kingpin-style strategy risks.
Mexico government intelligence-driven operation in Nuevo Leon destroys Sinaloa narco labs and surveillance systems. Part of Q1 2025 security surge along US border states.
Mexico federal forces raid CJNG avocado extortion ring in Uruapan. Cartel taxing avocado farms up to 30% of harvest value — affecting US consumer prices.
El Mencho killing declared major victory for Mexico's new cartel offensive. Helps reduce Trump pressure on Sheinbaum government. Could shift CJNG into fragmented post-leadership phase.
